heading-1-0.content:
Two years ago,
I was the person
Carousify was
built for.

text-1-0.content: That's not a marketing line. It's just true.

text-2-0.content:
• Open Canva. Find a template that doesn't look like everyone else's.

• Realize I had no idea what to write.

• Spend an hour with ChatGPT.

• Schedule it in a third tool.

• Never look at analytics because that was a fourth app.

text-3-0.content: I felt like I was doing a lot of work for no real payoff.

text-4-3.content: Same person. Same topic. Wildly different results.

text-5-0.content:
Without fast, connected data, I couldn't improve.
So I built the system I wanted.

text-6-0.content:
Friends asked to use it.
Then friends of friends.

text-6-2.content: The hardest part was deciding to stop adding features and actually ship.

heading-7-0.content:
If LinkedIn content
feels like a
second job with
no clear return

heading-7-1.content:
That's exactly what I built
Carousify to fix.

text-8-0.content: I'm genuinely curious. Drop your story below.
